From today, Runna subscription users can use the brand-new "Adapt for Heat" feature, which automatically adjusts pace targets based on local temperature and humidity. Here are the details.

Runna adds training tool to tackle high temperatures

The personalised running coach app Runna today announced three updates aimed at supporting users throughout their training cycle, covering everything from training in hot weather to post-race recovery.

The new "Adapt for Heat" feature, launching today, will help users identify cooler time slots for running and suggest adjusted pace targets based on feels-like temperature, training duration and specific sessions.

"Adapt for Heat" will display a colour-coded hourly weather forecast, allowing users to quickly identify the most suitable time slots for running and plan accordingly.

Here is Runna's introduction to this new feature:

Runna also announced the relaunch of its "Post-Race Recovery Plan" feature, which is automatically generated once users start a race plan ranging from 5km to 50km. Runna's Head Coach and former Olympian Steph Kessell said these plans are designed by professional coaches to help runners "reduce the risk of burnout or injury".

Finally, the platform announced a brand-new feature called "Upcoming Plans", set to launch in August. Users can schedule multiple training plans in advance and automatically transition from one plan to the next upon completion, further streamlining long-term training.

Here is Runna's introduction to the benefits of "Upcoming Plans":

Plan your full year of training in minutes: Runners can stack races, milestone goals and training cycles for full visibility across the year. Zero admin between plans: No rebuilds or starting over — your preferred training schedule, predicted race times and current fitness level carry over automatically when one plan ends and the next begins. Flexibility and full control: Every plan can be edited, swapped or removed at any time, so runners stay fully in charge of their training experience. Built for progress: Each plan is designed by Runna's expert coaches, grounded in proven training principles to support sustainable progress, recovery and race-day readiness.
